memories.text:
- Irritable bowel syndrome
  - Status: Abdominal bloating and alternating diarrhoea/constipation, mebeverine and ispaghula husk partially helpful.
  - Plan: Continue mebeverine 135 mg BD after food; ispaghula husk 5 g OD with water; add loperamide 2 mg SOS after loose stools; advise low‑FODMAP diet: breakfast – rice‑flakes with banana; lunch – khichdi with curd; dinner – steamed vegetables and rice.
- Chronic urticaria
  - Status: Daily wheals, mild pruritus, currently on levocetirizine 5 mg OD.
  - Plan: Continue levocetirizine 5 mg OD after food; add cetirizine 10 mg HS if nocturnal breakthrough.
- Vitamin B12 deficiency
  - Status: Fatigue, last B12 180 pg/mL (low).
  - Plan: Start methylcobalamin 1500 mcg OD after breakfast.
- Weight: 68 kg; Waist: 88 cm (female cut‑off 80 cm – central obesity).
- Due: Next HbA1c due 2025-07-05.
